title: Annual Exam Schedule | 2026
excerpt: The official examination timetable for the Annual Examination 2026 (Classes 6 to 9) has been published. Exams will commence on 19th November 2026 (Thursday) at 10:00 AM daily.

title: Inter-School Science Fair | Participation Open
excerpt: Kapotaksha High School is participating in the District Inter-School Science Fair on 15th August 2026. Students from classes 8 – 10 may register by submitting a project proposal before 30th July 2026.

title: KHS Students Excel in SSC Result 2026
excerpt: We are proud to announce a 98% pass rate in the SSC Examination 2026, with 42 students securing GPA 5.0. The school management congratulates all successful students.

title: Half-Yearly Exam Results Published
excerpt: Results of the Half-Yearly Examination 2026 have been published. Students may collect mark sheets from 8th July 2026. Parent – Teacher Meeting: 12th July at 10:00 AM.

title: Annual Sports Day | Registration Now Open
excerpt: The Annual Sports Day will be held on 20th September 2026. Students interested in athletic events must register with their Physical Education teacher by 10th September 2026.

title: School Fees Payment Reminder | July 2026
excerpt: All students are reminded to clear their fees for July 2026 by 15th July 2026. Late payment will attract a fine as per school policy. Queries: school accounts office 9 AM – 2 PM.
